_note: The period a gratuity's salary is averaged over (D-317; W-152). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 6 (pp.41–42), "A = average salary for ten months immediately preceding the month when any such event occurs". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10)(iii) (thc.nic.in p.71), "calculated on the basis of the average salary for the ten months immediately preceding the month in which any such event occurs", the words substituted by Act 4 of 1988 s.6 (w.e.f. 1-4-1989; p.71 footnote 3; which sub-clause of s.6 not read). SalaryAveragingPeriod 10: the months immediately preceding the event's month are averaged, by RET-GRATUITY-OTHER's half-month limb (AVERAGE_SALARY_BY_COMPLETED_YEARS); which pay counts is SAL-SALARY-FOR-GRATUITY's. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-21-gratuity-averaging.md.
